_readme: Hand corrections to supplier profiles (SCOUT). Key: supplier ID, or 'sup:...|part:...' for one part. Fields replace the computed value, 'notes' are added, keys starting with _ are comments. '_why' is required: the evidence, with doc/news IDs. Applied on every read - no rebuild needed.

sup:70140._why: MD: 'the bank is watching every month', asked twice to pay earlier, won't sign anything that lowers margin (doc:20260715-70140-M1); asks for payment in 10 days (doc:20260710-70140-M2); restructures (news:20260911-28); red scorecard (sc:70140@2026Q3)
